parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kitchen pot is made of stainless steel, circular in shape with a small handle on top.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot but does not move during cooking.

parts.name: Outlier (Handle)
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the kitchen pot is made of wood, cylindrical in shape, and attached to the side of the pot.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to hold and maneuver the pot safely without direct contact with the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the pot and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the kitchen pot is made of stainless steel, forming the main container for cooking.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for heating and cooking, distributing heat evenly across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and serves as the main structural component of the pot.
